title: Theorem on formal functions over a complete Noetherian base ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] (the ideal sheaf generated by the images of the elements of $I$), and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], with $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). For $p\ge0$ the quotient maps $\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ induce $A$-linear maps $H^p(X,\mathcal F)\to H^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] compatible with the maps induced by $\mathcal F/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$. Then the induced map $$H^p(X,\mathcal F)\longrightarrow\varprojlim_nH^p(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$$ is an isomorphism of $A$-modules for every $p\ge0$; in particular ($p=0$) $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)\to\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ is bijective.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087U (lemma-spell-out-theorem-formal-functions, line 5698); its proof: Theorem 02OC (theorem-formal-functions, line 5648), Lemma 02O6 (lemma-proper-over-affine-cohomology-finite: H^p finite over A) and Algebra, Lemma 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor: finite modules over a complete Noetherian ring are complete)

proof.text: Make X locally Noetherian using properness over Spec A. The coherence criterion gives quasi-coherence. Apply finite pushforward for the identity to obtain finite sections on every affine open; over its Noetherian coordinate ring these sections are finitely presented. The affine criterion and locality give finite presentation of F. Apply finite_sections_higherDirectImage (02O6, carried by lem-pc-coherent-hi), and the affine higher-direct-image/ordinary-cohomology semilinear comparison to obtain finite ordinary cohomology over Gamma(Spec A). The existing natural additive comparison from module cohomology to ordinary H respects scalars: apply its naturality to the scalar endomorphism smulHom, whose module-cohomology action is multiplication by the scalar. Bundle this as a Gamma(Spec A)-linear equivalence and transfer finiteness to module cohomology. Finally restrict scalars along the surjective ring isomorphism (GammaSpecIso A).inv, using LinearMap.finite_iff_of_bijective on the identity semilinear map, to obtain a finite A-module.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Theorem 02OC (theorem-formal-functions, line 5648), cited in the proof of Lemma 087U as 'a reformulation of the theorem on formal functions'

proof.text: Compose c with e. Rewrite each limit projection using the projection equation for e. After extensionality of ModuleCat morphisms and linear maps, AdicCompletion.ofLinearEquiv_apply and AdicCompletion.eval_of identify its value on x with theta_n applied to x modulo I^(n+1). The factorization equation for theta_n gives the required quotient-induced map. For global sections, evaluation preserves finite limits, so whisker rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf by restriction of scalars to obtain a natural isomorphism alpha from degree-zero module cohomology to global sections. Transport the source by alpha.app(F).symm and the target limit by HasLimit.isoOfNatIso of the whiskered alpha. The limit projection formula, the degree-zero result, naturality of alpha, and inverse cancellation give exactly the stated global-sections projection equation.
